paragraphs: R' Shami (שמי) and Shamai (שמיי). See the entry Shammai (שמאי).[^1]

notes.text: The three supplied spellings are שמי, שמיי and שמאי. Shami, Shamai and Shammai are conventional vocalizations; the title abbreviation remains R'. The notice gives a pointer, not an independent equivalence claim.
